payload.summary: CME: record missed teaching or supervision, with a linked replacement session
payload.detail: Review item D12. From a shift, record planned teaching or supervision lost to clinical work, the time lost and a brief non-patient reason, then link a replacement session. Missed teaching earns no CPD credit; the replacement is its own record. Nothing is sent to an employer without an explicit, permitted action. Not started.
payload.source: Master product review 2026-09-26 (thread: Review master review ideas); cross-checked against main 004ab6301
